skills.name: handoff
requires: Task context and a writable project folder
skills.example: Prepare a handoff so another coding agent can finish this branch. Include changes, checks, blockers, and the exact next action.

skills.name: create-tickets
requires: Project requirements or feedback; a tracker connection only for creating remote tickets
skills.example: Turn these requirements into scoped engineering tickets with dependencies and Given/When/Then acceptance criteria. Draft them locally.

skills.name: draft-prd
skills.example: Draft a PRD from these research notes. Separate evidence, assumptions, missing metrics, scope, and success criteria.

skills.name: draft-gtm
requires: A product, intended audience, and available customer evidence
skills.example: Use these customer interviews to draft positioning for this audience. Label unsupported differentiation claims as hypotheses.

skills.name: check-follow-ups
requires: Authorized read access to the user's email threads through available mail tools
skills.example: Find important email threads where I sent the last message and am waiting on a reply. Report only; do not send or create drafts.

skills.name: organize
requires: A configured shared knowledge vault with INDEX.md and authorized local file access
skills.example: File these notes in my configured vault, update the relevant index, and preserve their sources and distinct revisions.

skills.name: dream
requires: Configured vault, project root, and agent homes
Authorized local access to session history and memory
Harness scheduler only for nightly automation
skills.example: Run a Dream review of recent work using my configured vault and agent homes. Show archive candidates with --dry-run; do not promote lessons.

skills.name: dream-review
requires: Configured shared vault and agent-loop checkout
Existing Dream drafts marked ready and the user's review decisions
skills.example: Walk me through the ready Dream drafts one at a time. Show the evidence and proposed scope before promoting any lesson.
